applies_to: People on Apple Health for Adults, starting January 1, 2027, when they apply or renew.

ways_to_meet.text: Working at least 80 hours a month.
Enrolled in an education program at least half-time.
A work program for at least 80 hours a month.
Community service for at least 80 hours a month.
Work, school, a work program and volunteering that add up to at least 80 hours a month.

exemptions.question: Are you enrolled in Medicare Part A or B?
Do you get Apple Health through a program other than Apple Health for Adults?
Did you travel outside your community for care for a serious or complex condition, for you or your dependent?
Did you spend part or all of a month in a hospital, nursing home or similar inpatient care?
Do you live in an area where the President has declared a disaster?
Do you live in a county where unemployment is 1.5 times the national rate?
Do you get Apple Health as a foster care alumni (ages 18-26)?
Are you American Indian or Alaska Native?
Are you a parent, guardian, caretaker relative or family caregiver of a child under 14 or a person with a disability?
Are you a veteran with a total disability rating?
Do you have a serious health condition that makes it hard to work (medically frail)?
Do you get TANF or SNAP?
Are you in a drug or alcohol treatment program?
Are you in jail or prison, or were you released in the last 3 months?
